# `surrogate_lagfree_vortex`

one draw of the lag-free surrogate of the vortex chain (the same graph on a lag-free surrogate of the recording), its tile crossings over the level's tiles as a statistic.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_vortex --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_vortex --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_vortex --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --psd-statistic rest_psd_welch --cross-spectrum rest_crossspectrum_alpha --seed 1 --spatial-scale "parts 32" --all
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"}, read shape | yes |
| `kernel` | operator inverse kernel, from recording.manifold.0, where {"name": "$kernel", "params.inverse.measure": "$method"} | yes |
| `tiles` | selection ladder, manifold kernel.to (the surface's grid (`nxr-neuro run select_dyadic_surface` first)) | yes |
| `glued` | manifold surface, where {"name": "$glued_surface"} (the glued cortex (`nxr-neuro run glue` first)) | yes |
| `grid` | selection any, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording} time grid frames ${band} ${frames_per_cycle} per cycle"} (the band's frame grid (`nxr-neuro run select_time_grid --rule frames --band 8-12Hz` first)) | yes |
| `bursts` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$bursts"} | yes |
| `threshold` | statistic histogram, where {"name": "$threshold_statistic"} | yes |
| `psd` | statistic welch, where {"name": "$psd_statistic"} | yes |
| `cross_spectrum` | statistic welch, where {"name": "$cross_spectrum"} | yes |
| `power_series` | measurement power, of recording, where {"name": "$power_series_over"} (the data's band power per tile: `nxr-neuro run measure --set surrogate_lagfree_envelope` first) | yes |
| `psd_channel_mean` | measurement mean, of psd, where {"name": "$psd_channel_mean_over"} (the PSD's mean over channels, a stored measurement (`nxr-neuro run measure --set psd_channel_mean` first), read by name) | yes |
| `bad` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording}_bad_segments"}, required false | no |
| `onset` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$onset"}, required false | no |
| `within` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$within"}, required false | no |
| `offset` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$offset"}, required false | no |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`synthesis.lagfree_mixing`](../nodes.md) | cross_spectrum=cross_spectrum |  | mixing |
| chunks over `recording` | [`synthesis.lagfree`](../nodes.md) | x=recording, psd=psd, psd_channel_mean=psd_channel_mean, cross_spectrum=cross_spectrum, power_series=power_series | band=$band, shape=$shape, taps_half=$taps_half, seed=$seed | y |
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.analytic_frames`](../nodes.md) | x=y, tiling=grid, within=bursts | band=$band, shape=$shape, frames_per_cycle=$frames_per_cycle, frames_per_tile=$frames_per_tile, origin=$origin | z_frames |
| chunks over `recording` | [`meeg.apply_kernel`](../nodes.md) | x=z_frames, kernel=kernel, tiles=tiles, glued=glued, pre_operator=mixing | spatial_scale=$spatial_scale, transform=$transform, modes=$modes, order=$order, tolerance=$tolerance, spatial_shape=$spatial_shape, form=curl_tan | curl_frames |
| chunks over `recording` | [`select.events.cores`](../nodes.md) | x=curl_frames, threshold=threshold, exclude=bad | percentile=$percentile, block_frames=$block_frames, bad_segments=$bad_segments | cores, frame, sense, centre_vertex, centre, area, peak |
| after | [`select.events.tracks`](../nodes.md) | events=cores, frame=frame, sense=sense, centre=centre | link_mm=$link_mm, min_frames=$min_frames | tracks, track_first_frame, track_last_frame, track_n_frames, track_path_length, track_displacement, track_sense, core_track |
| after | [`select.tile_crossings`](../nodes.md) | events=cores, frame=frame, sense=sense, centre=centre, track=core_track, tiles=tiles, onset=onset, within=within, offset=offset | spatial_scale=$spatial_scale, stages=$stages, as=statistic | null_crossings |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `null_crossings` | kind statistic |

## Notes from the definition

```text
ONE DRAW OF THE LAG-FREE SURROGATE of the vortex chain (spec docs/specs/2026-11-17-surrogates.md): the SAME graph as `vortex_cores`, run on a lag-free surrogate of the recording in place of the
recording: Gaussian noise with the data's own spectrum (the stored Welch PSD), scaled to the data's band envelope (`run measure --set surrogate_lagfree_envelope`), mixed by the square root of the band's real cross-spectrum
(the zero-lag structure kept, no lag). The threshold is the DATA's (the stored `vortex_core_threshold` histogram, by name), the burst frames the data's: only the signal is replaced.
THE ORDER (spec section 4): white -> shaping taps -> envelope scale (`synthesis.lagfree`, the UNMIXED draw) -> the band's analytic signal -> frames -> ONE fused operator (the curl of the
kernel's tangent current through the level's hat, composed with the zero-lag mixing: apply_kernel's `pre_operator`). It is the same draw as mixing first: the scale is the same number on every channel
of a sample, and the analytic filter and the frame sampling are the same linear filter on every channel, so the mixing commutes with them; the kernel, the tangent part, the curl and the hat are linear,
so they and the mixing are one operator [vertices x channels], built once and cached across the draws. The first non-linear step is `cores` (the threshold).
A DRAW NEVER READS THE RECORDING: `read: shape` hands the chunk loop the recording's shape (channels, rate, span, chunk grid) and its good samples, no sample.
A draw is the run with `seed: i` (the seed is in the cache key and in the stored node's name: `draw: seed`); only the draw's TILE CROSSINGS are stored, as a statistic over the level's tiles beside the
recording (`surrogate_lagfree_vortex.draw<seed>.null_crossings.<recording>`), small; the surrogate and the draw's cores and tracks are never stored.
`run surrogate_lagfree_vortex_compare` runs the draws in batches with early stopping and compares the data's crossings with them over the same tiles.

  nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_vortex --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --psd-statistic rest_psd_welch --cross-spectrum rest_crossspectrum_alpha --seed 1 --spatial-scale "parts 32" --all
```
